title: sortByTierFit has no tie-break and the sort is unstable
notes: Reproduced then fixed 2026-08-17. Fixed with an input-index tie-break rather than a secondary ranking on title/id/duration, which would have been a personalisation decision disguised as a bug fix. Both new tests fail against HEAD and pass after.
